description: This source file defines the 'StuckGrain' class and its related cleanup class 'StuckCleanupGrain' within the Orleans framework, implementing various activation and deactivation behaviors, including blocking, releasing, and tracking grain state for testing purposes.

classes.name: StuckGrain
classes.description: A grain class that implements mechanisms to simulate stuck or blocked activation/deactivation behaviors for testing Orleans grains.

classes.name: StuckCleanupGrain
classes.description: A helper grain class that interacts with 'StuckGrain' to release or check activation status, mainly used for testing cleanup and state management.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases a grain by setting its associated TaskCompletionSource to true and removing it from the tracking dictionary.

methods.name: WaitForDeactivationStart
methods.description: Returns a task that completes when the grain's deactivation is triggered, waiting with a timeout.

methods.name: SetDeactivationStarted
methods.description: Marks that deactivation has started by setting the ManualResetEventSlim.

methods.name: BlockCallingTestUntilDeactivation
methods.description: Blocks further deactivation or related calls until explicitly unblocked.

methods.name: IsActivated
methods.description: Checks if a given grain identified by a Guid is currently activated.

methods.name: RunForever
methods.description: Returns a task that never completes unless externally triggered, simulating a stuck grain.

methods.name: NonBlockingCall
methods.description: Increments a counter for the primary key and completes asynchronously.

methods.name: GetNonBlockingCallCounter
methods.description: Returns the count of non-blocking calls made to this grain.

methods.name: DidActivationTryToStart
methods.description: Checks if the activation process was attempted for a specific grain id.

methods.name: BlockingDeactivation
methods.description: Triggers a blocking deactivation process, causing the grain to not deactivate immediately.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles logic upon grain activation, including optional delay for testing, and state registration.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles logic upon grain deactivation, including cleanup and optional blocking to simulate stuck states.

methods.name: Release (in StuckCleanupGrain)
methods.description: Calls 'StuckGrain.Release' to release a grain from a stuck state.

methods.name: IsActivated (in StuckCleanupGrain)
methods.description: Checks if a specific grain is currently activated via 'StuckGrain.IsActivated'.
